result:
The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's pivot away from Ensembl, which is where the correct answer lives (the release-101 GFF3 on `ftp.ensembl.org`).

At step 8, WebSurfer's click on the Ensembl search result hit a one-off DNS error. Instead of retrying or going directly to the Ensembl FTP site, the Orchestrator dropped Ensembl at step 10 and sent WebSurfer to NCBI. NCBI does not give the dated Ensembl release GFF3 link. The rest of the run wandered through unrelated NCBI papers and the Genome Data Viewer. It then hit the time limit and returned an NCBI Genome Data Viewer link as the final answer.

AGENT: Orchestrator (-> WebSurfer)
STEP: 10
